name: Makishima Yuuto
source:
A professional gamer who belongs to a different team than Keiji.
Ever since playing against Keiji in a game before going pro and losing, he has viewed Keiji as a rival.
He is highly self-confident, haughty, and arrogant—having what is known as a domineering ("ore-sama") personality. However, he is strict with both himself and others, and due to his uncompromising words and actions, he has gained popularity as a professional gamer in a villainous (heel) role.
He is strictly gay.
From [url=https://www.akabeesoft2.com/products/denshi_otome/index.html]Official Website[/url]
